hints: How does the exponential expression connect to repeated growth or to its logarithmic inverse?
arguments.solution_sketch: Compute the product of ${a}$ copies of $2.71828$. To round to the requested step, multiply by ${b}$, round to a whole number, then divide by ${b}$.
arguments.statement: Using only the supplied approximation $e\approx2.71828$, evaluate $e^{{{a}}}$ and round the computed value to the nearest $1/{b}$.
